context_audit.day_semantics: watch_start calendar date, not normalised-second day number
context_audit.preference_unit: one confirmed user/channel/canonical airing, no source-row repetition
context_audit.recency_policy: mean per-event exp2(-(cutoff-watch_end)/(30 days)); no count-wide last-time substitution

decision_rule.early_selection: one main winner frozen before early evaluation; no runner-up search on early
decision_rule.scope: descriptive post-selection intervals; earlier window is temporal robustness, not untouched confirmation

versus_control.limitation: descriptive post-selection bootstrap; not corrected for model selection and not an independent test

external_methodology: No new external methodology or code; extends existing PPR and rank fusion implementations.

early.earlier_window_limitation: earlier temporal robustness check, not an untouched confirmatory test
early.event_policy: one >50% qualified user/channel/canonical-airing event; full airing bounds and first/last qualified watch endpoints

main.event_policy: one >50% qualified user/channel/canonical-airing event; full airing bounds and first/last qualified watch endpoints

limitations: Repeated selection on one holdout; bootstrap intervals are descriptive, not selection-adjusted.
Early data already occur in main training; temporal robustness is not an untouched independent test.
Calendar channel/time preferences are proxies; absolute timezone and actual devices remain unknown.

convergence.dangling_policy: redistribute dangling mass to the same user's seed
convergence.repeat_policy: seed items remain eligible; no already-watched filter
convergence.seed_normalisation: own train binary/log1p counts divided by row sum

graph.edge_policy: directed per-row top-K column cosine, no self loops and no symmetric closure
graph.edge_tie_break: similarity descending, numeric item ID ascending
graph.history_signal: binary train interactions; raw counts do not weight graph edges
graph.user_normalisation: divide each binary user row by sqrt(user degree)

versus_control.limitation: descriptive post-selection bootstrap; not corrected for model selection and not an independent test
